name: Bergjuwel
beschreibung: The Bergjuwel is a hotel in Neustift im Stubaital, Tirol. The village lies in the Stubaital and is a destination for mountain tourists. The hotel offers rooms and apartments with various amenities. Wellness areas such as sauna and relaxation rooms are available. Hiking is possible in summer and skiing in winter. The dining options include regional and international cuisine. The staff assists with planning excursions.
